name: usage-band
description: Band above the prompt showing context %, tools, skills and MCP share of context, and session and weekly limits, with yellow and red usage indicators

showTools.title: Show tools
showTools.description: Loaded tools share of the context window.

showSkills.title: Show skills

showWeek.title: Show weekly limit
showWeek.description: The seven-day rate-limit window and when it resets (subscriptions only).
